2.284.12
CustomReportItem.Label
Applies to RDL 2005/01
The CustomReportItem.Label element specifies a document map label to identify a
CustomReportItem within a rendered report. This element is optional and MUST NOT be specified
more than once. If this element is specified, its value MUST be a String ([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section
3.2.1) or an expression that evaluates to a Variant.
Following is the parent element of the CustomReportItem.Label element.
Parent elements
CustomReportItem
The following is the XML Schema definition of the CustomReportItem.Label element.
 <xsd:element name="Label" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
